nora: Zoom webinar 555-123-987 scheduled 2026-07-06T16:00:00Z. Cloud recording + transcript ON. Q&A enabled, practice session at 15:00Z. Alternate host = @leo. RTMP fallback enabled; stream key in 1Password /events/launch-lab.

ops-bot: [notice] Zoom webinar created. Cloud recording set to enabled. Auto-transcription enabled. Asset folder: Redwood/Events/2026-launch-lab.

nora: I can clip AMA 1:10-1:40 and burn captions. Upload to HS files by Mon EOD. Backup: ffmpeg capture to ops box if cloud fails: `ffmpeg -i rtmp://vimeo/fallback -c copy /tmp/launchlab.mp4`.

leo: Owners: reg page + HS copy = @sasha, clip + captions = @nora, workflow & emails = @leo. Confirm?
sasha: Confirmed. I'll post final checklist in handbook and ping channel when green. :rocket:
